## Research answers

1. **Should this work wait behind RichAuto DSP A11?**
   Yes. Issues `#1914` (`richauto.cps`) and `#1915` (Laguna and Grizzly A11 `.mch` files) remain open. `assets/posts/richauto.cps` is not on `main` yet. Hold implementation behind `#1914`, `#1915`, and hardware test cuts. Independent platform prep (UI file extensions and per-machine post lookup) can move ahead now.

2. **Does WinCNC use `G21` or `G22` for millimeters?**
   WinCNC uses `G22` for millimeters. WinCNC User's Manuals (versions 2.5, 3.0, and later, `wincnc.com`) define `G20` as inches, `G21` as centimeters, `G22` as millimeters, and `G23` as return to the previous unit. Standard WinCNC controllers scale geometry by 10x if a millimeter program emits `G21`. The post must emit `G22` for millimeters and `G20` for inches, unless `WINCNC.INI` on the machine remaps them.

3. **How do WinCNC comments, cycles, macros, and extensions work?**
   Per `wincnc.com` manuals, WinCNC marks comments with square brackets `[...]`. Parentheses and semicolons do not act as native WinCNC comment delimiters. `G4 X<sec>` dwells for seconds, while bare `G4` waits for Enter. `G91.1` selects incremental `I`/`J` arc centers for `G2`/`G3`. `L91` runs one relative move block. `G53` moves in machine coordinates, and bare `G53` retracts vertical axes home. Canned cycles `G81` (`X Y Z R F`) and `G83` (`X Y Z R Q F`) cancel via `G80`, `G0`, or `G1`. `G43` activates tool offsets saved by `M37`. Controller macros in `CNC.MAC` execute `M3`, `M5`, `M6`, `M2`, and `M30`. WinCNC uses `.tap` output files.

4. **What specs and checks apply to Laguna `MCNC Swift` WinCNC machines?**
   Laguna specifications list `48" x 48"` (`4x4`), `48" x 96"` (`4x8`), and `60" x 120"` (`5x10`) XY travels with `~6"` to `7.5"` Z travel. Rapid traverse reaches `900 IPM`. The spindle is a 3 HP liquid-cooled ER20 electrospindle running `6,000 - 24,000 RPM`. Later Swift machines ship with Laguna DSP controllers, while earlier or custom builds use WinCNC. Verify `WINCNC.INI` unit settings and `M6`/`M37` macros on real hardware before shipping WinCNC `.mch` files. Follow `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md` (`general.vendor = "Camcraft"`, `safe_retract`).

5. **How does CamCraft satisfy DSP-J2 ANSI encoding, comments, and line endings?**
   The Grizzly `G0403` Owner's Manual (`grizzly.com`) mandates plain ANSI text with no Unicode on FAT16/FAT32 USB drives (`.tap` or `.nc`). `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs` (`run_program_with`) joins lines with `\n` into UTF-8 `String` without a BOM. `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (`post_script_body`) writes `out.program.as_bytes()`. `crates/post/src/post/js.rs` ignores `setCodePage`. Keep `dsp-j2.cps` output within printable 7-bit ASCII so every file is valid ANSI with zero BOM. Grizzly firmware changelogs (`grizzly.com`) document fixes for DSP-J2 comment parsing (`(...)`, `;`) and `CR LF` / `LF` line endings. Suppress inline comments by default and keep line endings configurable for hardware tests.

6. **What dialect and machine values apply to DSP-J2 and `Grizzly G0403`?**
   Per `grizzly.com` and Wixhc DSP-J2 docs, the controller supports `G00`-`G03` (`I`/`J` or `R`), `G20`/`G21`, `G54`-`G59` (8 programmable UI work offsets), `G90`/`G91`, `M03`-`M05`, and `M02`/`M30`. Support for `G81`/`G83` varies across DSP-J2 firmware builds. Expand drill cycles to plain `G00`/`G01` moves (matching `assets/posts/carvera.cps`). Tool changes require a spindle stop (`M05`), safe retract, and a manual pause or lift. Grizzly `G0403` specs state `13"` X x `25-9/16"` Y x `7-1/16"` Z travel, `118 IPM` rapid speed, and a `65 mm / 68 mm` router mount (optional `T34438` 2 HP VFD spindle `0 - 24,000 RPM`).

7. **How should RichAuto DSP B18 4-axis handle axis letters (`C` vs `A`) and feedrates?**
   RichAuto B18 pendant keys label the 4th axis `C+`/`C-`. Factory firmware reads `C` in degrees, though machine builders can remap the letter to `A` in setup. Under `G94`, rotary-only `F` specifies `deg/min`. Combined linear and rotary moves mix millimeter feeds with degree feeds, so simultaneous 4-axis paths normally use `G93` inverse-time feedrate. Start with indexed `3+1` moves and rotary feed capping (`crates/post/src/post/rotary_cap.rs`, similar to `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` and `assets/posts/tormach.cps`). Verify `G93` time units (`1/min` vs `1/hr`) on real B18 firmware before enabling simultaneous 4-axis output.

8. **What blocks a horizontal `C` rotary axis in CamCraft today?**
   `crates/post/src/machine/kind.rs` (`kind()`) infers `Kind::MillTurn` instead of `Kind::Mill` when a rotary axis omits `axis` or aligns with `[0, 0, 1]`. `crates/app/tests/machine.rs` (`every_shipped_machine_mounts_and_speaks_its_declaration`) fails when inferred `Kind` differs from `axes_say`. `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs` (`only_x_rotary`) maps `x_tool_angle` only for one X-aligned rotary (`[1, 0, 0]`). Any Y-aligned rotary (`[0, 1, 0]`) named `C` hits `c_letter_problem` and refuses non-zero `B`. `crates/app/src/operation/rotary_gate.rs` (`stamp_spindle_c`) handles vertical Z `C` axes only. `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary.rs` (`rotary_parallel`) assumes an X-aligned rotary axis. Keep `.mch` definitions compliant with RS-274 axis letters (`A` about X, `B` about Y in `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`). Map the output G-code letter (`C`, `A`, or `B`) in the post and `crates/post/src/post/dialect.rs` (`Dump::abc`).

9. **What machine values and manual checks apply to `Grizzly G0932`?**
   Grizzly `G0932` specs state `51-3/16"` X x `98-7/16"` Y x `7-7/8"` Z travel, `1,181 IPM` XY rapid, `400 IPM` Z rapid, and `472 IPM` C-axis rapid. The rotary attachment provides a `7-7/8"` swing over bed, 3-jaw chuck, tailstock, and 20:1 reducer. The spindle is a 4 HP HSD air-cooled motor (`0 - 18,000 RPM` on datasheet, ER25 collet). Public `G0932` pages do not specify factory rotary mounting along X vs Y on the table. Confirm the factory chuck axis and minimum air-cooled spindle RPM in the printed `G0932` manual before creating `grizzly-g0932.mch`.

10. **Why does `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` conflict with Sinumerik `808D Advanced`?**
    Per Siemens `808D ADVANCED` Milling manuals (`siemens.com`), `G290` selects Siemens mode (reset default) and `G291` selects ISO Dialect mode. Each switch command must stand alone in one NC block. Mixing ISO and Siemens commands raises Alarm 12710. Today `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` (written for 840D) emits Siemens commands (`G710`/`G700`, `G505`/`G506`, `CYCLE832`, `MEAS=1`) together with ISO drill cycles (`G81`-`G89`) and `T<n> D<n> M6`. Target native Siemens `G290` mode on `808D Advanced`. Emit standalone `G290`, use `T<n> D1 M6` (cutting edge `D1`), and use Siemens drilling cycles (`CYCLE81`-`CYCLE83`) instead of `G81`-`G89`. Gate `CYCLE832`, `MEAS=1`, and rigid tapping `CYCLE84` behind machine capabilities.

11. **How do `.MPF` USB files, GUI extensions, and `Grizzly G0934` specs align?**
    `808D Advanced` imports `.mpf` Main Program Files from front USB, optionally starting with `%_N_<NAME>_MPF`. Today `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` declares `extension = "nc"`. Also, single-file UI Post (`crates/ui/src/post_file.rs` `PROGRAM_EXT = "nc"`, `crates/ui/src/state.rs` filter `["nc"]`) ignores `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs` (`extension_of`), while multi-mount posting (`crates/app/src/posting_mounts.rs`) already reads it. Pass the active extension from `app` to the UI Save dialog (`ui -> app -> flecs` rule in `AGENTS.md`) so `.tap` and `.mpf` export directly. For `Grizzly G0934`, `grizzly.com` lists `59-1/16" x 118-1/8" x 7-7/8"` cutting area, 12 HP HSD ER32 spindle (`0 - 24,000 RPM`), 8-position rotary ATC, and 850W Simotics S-1FL6 servos. Public specs omit axis rapid speeds. Read G0934 rapid speeds and min spindle RPM from the machine manual or 808D machine data before adding `.mch`.

12. **How do `.mch` files map to their matching posts in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`?**
    Today `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (`default_post_for(Kind)`) reads only `Kind` and returns `PostRef::Builtin` (Fanuc) for every `Kind::Mill` machine. Add a machine-level default post lookup beside `default_post_for` (or extend `MACHINES` / `post_serves` matching). Then router `.mch` files preselect their controller post while generic mills keep Fanuc as fallback.

---

## Design proposal (smallest useful first slice first)

Hold controller `.cps` and `.mch` PRs behind `#1914` and `#1915` hardware feedback, then build in this order:

1. **Slice 0 (Platform prep, independent):**
   - Route `engine::extension_of` through `app` to `crates/ui/src/post_file.rs` and `crates/ui/src/state.rs` so single-file export uses `.tap` and `.mpf`.
   - Extend `crates/app/src/posting.rs` so shipped router machines resolve their matching default post while generic `Kind::Mill` keeps Fanuc.
2. **Slice 1 (Smallest controller + benchtop router): `DSP-J2` + `Grizzly G0403`**
   - Build `assets/posts/dsp-j2.cps` from `carvera.cps` and `richauto.cps` (#1914) patterns: 7-bit ASCII/ANSI with no BOM, expanded `G00`/`G01` drills, manual `M06` retract/pause, and comments off by default.
   - Add `assets/machines/grizzly-g0403.mch` once `dsp-j2.cps` passes `conformance.rs`.
3. **Slice 2 (Existing post fix + ATC router): `Sinumerik 808D Advanced` + `Grizzly G0934`**
   - Fix dialect mixing in `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps`, support standalone `G290` (`CYCLE81`-`CYCLE83`, `T<n> D1 M6`, `.mpf`, `%_N_..._MPF`), gate `CYCLE832`/`MEAS=1`/`CYCLE84`, and update goldens.
   - Add `assets/machines/grizzly-g0934.mch` after reading rapid speeds and min RPM from manual data.
4. **Slice 3 (Macro-driven router): `WinCNC` + Laguna `MCNC Swift`**
   - Add `assets/posts/wincnc.cps` (`G20` inch, `G22` mm, `[...]` comments, `G91.1`, `L91`, `G53`, `G4 X`, `G81`/`G83`/`G80`, `G43`, macro `M6`, `.tap`).
   - Add earlier WinCNC Laguna `mcnc-swift-*.mch` files after verifying `WINCNC.INI` and `CNC.MAC` macros on a WinCNC Swift.
5. **Slice 4 (4th-axis rotary): kinematics decoupling + `RichAuto B18` + `Grizzly G0932`**
   - Update `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/dialect.rs`, and `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary.rs` so horizontal X or Y rotary axes stay `Kind::Mill` and posts choose output letter `C`, `A`, or `B`.
   - Extend `richauto.cps` (#1914) for B18 4-axis output (`3+1` indexed with `rotary_cap.rs` first, then `G94`/`G93` continuous after firmware checks), and add `assets/machines/grizzly-g0932.mch` after verifying factory chuck orientation.

## Proposed sub-issues (not filed yet; awaiting P8 approval)

1. **UI: use active post `.cps` extension in single-file Save dialog**
   - Pass `extension_of` through `app` into `crates/ui/src/post_file.rs` and `crates/ui/src/state.rs` instead of hardcoding `"nc"`.
   - Done means: Single-file Post uses `.tap` or `.mpf` when declared by the active `.cps`, keeps `.nc` fallback, and passes UI tests.
   - Proposed priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:ui`, `area:post`

2. **Post: map `.mch` machines to matching default posts in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`**
   - Add per-machine default post selection in `crates/app/src/posting.rs` while keeping Fanuc fallback for generic `Kind::Mill`.
   - Done means: Non-Fanuc routers preselect their controller post via `posting.rs`, existing machines pass unchanged, and unit tests verify both cases.
   - Proposed priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:post`

3. **Post: add Wixhc DSP-J2 post (`assets/posts/dsp-j2.cps`) with conformance goldens**
   - Implement 3-axis DSP-J2 output with printable 7-bit ASCII/ANSI compliance, no BOM, expanded linear drills, manual tool change pause, and comments off by default.
   - Done means: `dsp-j2.cps` registers in `BUILTINS` and `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`, outputs ASCII-only `.nc`/`.tap`, and passes all conformance checks.
   - Proposed priority: `P7` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`

4. **Machines: add Grizzly G0403 benchtop CNC router `.mch` definition**
   - Add `assets/machines/grizzly-g0403.mch` (`13" x 25-9/16" x 7-1/16"`, `118 IPM` rapid, DSP-J2) matching the Grizzly manual.
   - Done means: `grizzly-g0403.mch` registers in `MACHINES`, maps to `DSP-J2`, and passes `crates/app/tests/machine.rs` and `crates/app/tests/machine_library.rs`.
   - Proposed priority: `P7` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:post`

5. **Post: adapt `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` for Sinumerik 808D Advanced (`G290`, `CYCLE81`-`CYCLE83`, `.mpf`)**
   - Fix `G290`/`G81` dialect mixing, support standalone `G290` with `T<n> D1 M6`, Siemens drilling cycles, `.mpf` + `%_N_..._MPF` header, and capability gating.
   - Done means: `sinumerik.cps` passes `conformance.rs` and `sinumerik_work_offsets` goldens for both 840D and 808D Advanced without mixing dialects.
   - Proposed priority: `P7` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`

6. **Machines: add Grizzly G0934 5'x10' ATC router `.mch` definition**
   - Add `assets/machines/grizzly-g0934.mch` (`59-1/16" x 118-1/8" x 7-7/8"`, 12 HP ER32, 8-position ATC, 808D Advanced) after confirming manual rapid speeds and min RPM.
   - Done means: `grizzly-g0934.mch` cites manual rapid and spindle limits, maps to Sinumerik 808D, and passes `machine.rs` and `machine_library.rs`.
   - Proposed priority: `P8` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:post`

7. **Post: add WinCNC post (`assets/posts/wincnc.cps`) with conformance goldens**
   - Implement WinCNC `.tap` dialect (`[...]` comments, `G20` inch, `G22` mm, `G91.1`, `L91`, `G53`, `G4 X`, `G81`/`G83`/`G80`, `G43` and `M6` macros).
   - Done means: `wincnc.cps` registers in `BUILTINS` and `conformance.rs` and passes golden checks without emitting `G21` (cm) for millimeters.
   - Proposed priority: `P8` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`

8. **Machines: add earlier WinCNC Laguna `MCNC Swift` `.mch` definitions**
   - Add WinCNC-equipped Laguna `MCNC Swift` machine files (`4x4`, `4x8`, `5x10`; `900 IPM`; 3 HP ER20) after checking `WINCNC.INI` and `CNC.MAC` on hardware.
   - Done means: WinCNC Swift `.mch` files document hardware-checked unit/macro settings, map to `WinCNC`, and pass `machine.rs` and `machine_library.rs`.
   - Proposed priority: `P8` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:post`

9. **Post & Motion: support horizontal Y-aligned rotaries and post-level axis letter remapping**
   - Update `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/dialect.rs`, and `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary.rs` so X- or Y-mounted horizontal 4th axes stay `Kind::Mill` while posts choose output letters (`C`, `A`, `B`).
   - Done means: Horizontal X and Y 4-axis `.mch` configs pass `machine.rs` as `Kind::Mill` and post rotary moves under post-selected letters with unit tests.
   - Proposed priority: `P8` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`

10. **Post: extend `richauto.cps` for RichAuto DSP B18 4-axis rotary output**
    - Add B18 4-axis mode to `richauto.cps` (`#1914`), emitting `C` (or `A`), indexed `3+1` with `rotary_cap.rs` feed capping first, and `G94`/`G93` continuous support after firmware checks.
    - Done means: B18 4-axis variant in `richauto.cps` passes `conformance.rs` goldens for indexed rotary motion and configurable `C`/`A` output.
    - Proposed priority: `P8` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`

11. **Machines: add Grizzly G0932 4'x8' 4-axis CNC router `.mch` definition**
    - Add `assets/machines/grizzly-g0932.mch` (`51-3/16" x 98-7/16" x 7-7/8"`, `1,181/400/472 IPM` rapids, `7-7/8"` swing, 4 HP ER25) after verifying factory chuck orientation (X vs Y) in the manual.
    - Done means: `grizzly-g0932.mch` sets the verified horizontal rotary axis vector as `Kind::Mill`, maps to RichAuto B18, and passes `machine.rs` and `machine_library.rs`.
    - Proposed priority: `P8` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:post`
